resources.string: OpenDisplay on the connecting Mac is too old for this app. Update it there to reconnect.
Pick this %1$s under WiFi in OpenDisplay on your computer
Keep this app open. Streaming starts automatically.
Tip: shake the %1$s to open settings anytime
OpenDisplay turns this %1$s into a second screen for your Mac. It needs the OpenDisplay Mac app running on a Mac on the same WiFi network.
Install the OpenDisplay Mac app on your Mac
Join the same WiFi as your Mac
You can find this link again anytime in Settings: shake the %1$s to open it.
Shown in the WiFi list of OpenDisplay on your computer.
The overlay shows FPS, bitrate, decode time and latency at the bottom of the screen while streaming.

What this %1$s saw while connecting: sessions, restarts, decoder trouble. No screen content and nothing leaves the %1$s unless you share it. Attach it to a GitHub issue if a connection won\'t come up.
WiFi: both devices on the same network, then pick this %1$s in OpenDisplay on your computer.
Rotate the %1$s for a vertical second monitor.
Touch: tap to click, drag to drag, two-finger pan to scroll.
Pen: draw with pressure and tilt. Fingers are ignored while the pen touches.
OpenDisplay needs the Mac app running on a Mac on the same WiFi network. Download it here if you haven\'t yet.
